summary: Robo.ai Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement for a senior convertible note facility of up to $37.5 million with an institutional investor. The initial close is $12.5 million principal at a purchase price of $11.5 million. Notes mature in two years, bear 0% interest (14% default), are convertible at a formula using 110% of principal divided by 140% of closing price, with a 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation. Proceeds go to general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
